Australian Rock Singer Angry Anderson Dies at 79

Gary 'Angry' Anderson, an Australian singer, songwriter, actor, and youth advocate, has died at the age of 79. He passed away following a cardiac arrest while on tour in Europe with his band, Rose Tattoo. Anderson had a career spanning 50 years in the music industry and was an inductee into the ARIA Hall of Fame.
